name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-learning-designer
title: Learning Designer
shortDescription: Turns a Learning Request Brief from a SharePoint Structured Document Generation form into a self-contained HTML learning dashboard with up to 3 stages, flashcards, practice and checks.
longDescription: Reads a Learning Request Brief .docx generated from a Structured Document Generation form and maps every field — topic, audience, goals, up to three stages, flashcard concepts, practice exercise, success criteria, knowledge checks and next steps — into a guided learning dashboard.

The output is one self-contained HTML file that follows the bundled reference dashboard: a staged learning path, Why / When / How / Check blocks, CSS flip cards and an optional embedded overview visual. Content is grounded in the brief's authoritative source, and unverified details are flagged with a visible warning.
